what: Hovering the pill button makes the dot left of the text hop to the third letter: once at half the height of the remaining distance, then once more to the end (.1375s cubic.out/in, sideways .275s straight each). The third letter where the dot lands squashes flat for .11s after .22s, and a small figure (a person) rises above it tilted ±20° with .22s back.out(2). The text shifts 10px left in .55s expo.out. On release the dot sags down by half its width and returns in .35s, and the figure drops in .175s

options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text slot (child) for the dot and text — if none, the element itself
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: Small image that rises above the text (child, optional) — the part wraps it in a mask slot
options.char: Letter index (from 0) where the dot lands and the image rises, default 2
options.dur: Crossing duration (s), default .55 — one bounce is a quarter of that
options.shift: Distance the text shifts left (px), default 10
options.drop: Depth at which the image hides (px), default 45
options.--fx-rider-w: Width of the picture mask cell (via style), default 30px
options.--fx-rider-h: Image mask cell height (via style), default 50px

note: On touch devices the dot just stays still and does not move (the original doesn’t attach it on phones either)
